council_map.vintage: Service description 'Mishawaka Council Districts 2023'; city also posts 'Current Council District Boundaries (2023)' PDFs
council_map.notes: returnCountOnly -> {"count":9}. Query shows one feature each for DISTRICT 1-6 (precinct field values 0901-0906, NAME = council member) and three features with DISTRICT 'At-Large' (NAMEs Gregg Hixenbaugh, Matt Mammolenti, Lacy Hahn). So count 9 = 6 districts + 3 at-large entries, not 9 geographic districts; at-large features should not be treated as district polygons. Saved: raw/mishawaka-in/layer0-query.json, layer0-count.json. Layer has NAME, PHONE, EMAIL fields. MapServer (not FeatureServer), spatial ref wkid 2244/2965.
